description: This PHP class defines a PasswordHasher used within the PhpSpreadsheet library to hash passwords for document protection, supporting multiple algorithms and methods based on Microsoft Office cryptography standards.

classes.name: PasswordHasher
classes.description: A utility class for hashing passwords using various algorithms, with support for legacy and modern cryptography standards within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: getAlgorithm
methods.description: Maps the provided algorithm name from Excel to a PHP-recognized algorithm name or throws an exception if unsupported.

methods.name: defaultHashPassword
methods.description: Generates a password hash based on a bitwise algorithm, following the Microsoft Office specification for binary document password verification.

methods.name: hashPassword
methods.description: Public method to create a hashed password using a specified algorithm, salt, and iteration count, supporting both default and specified hash algorithms.
